items.q: I never heard him in person. ... I heard a couple of things that he did

ctx.x: disgusting. Because the guys that did this to make a dollar, you know what I mean, they weren't being creative or anything and it was just a downer. Yeah, yeah.

Then, of course, jazz itself, when it became popular...it's phase of popularity in the '60's, it was quite a different style, for the most part, from that which you came up with. Ornette Coleman, John Coltrane in his later years...

Well, that's another thing in itself, you see. When Coltrane came out with his thing, people said his tone was terrible, but what they didn't realize is that John Coltrane was a student, a serious student of music, you know what I mean. And he eventually came on through there. But that period of creation was a very chaotic situation. The guys were trying to create something new and they got adverse publicity.
